notes: This contract pins Umbra's bounded IEEE 1516.1-2025 Next Message Request Available service to source-derived clause 8.11. The embedded profile selects the earliest currently queued TSO timestamp for the recipient when it is no greater than the supplied request, delivers its timestamp cohort through the callback-gated Time Advance Grant path, and applies the Available form's inclusive GALT boundary. The separate bounded timestamped-save integration case exercises the exclusive save-admission boundary: an equal grant does not admit a save, while a later one does. Future transport input, asynchronous delivery, complete LITS/GALT coordination, Flush Queue Grant, complete save/restore, package/catalog evidence, protected review, and conformance remain outside this slice.
